facts.fact: The Independent reports the Auditor General's FY2024/25 review of 30 local governments found staff using IRAS for assessment, receipting, reconciliation and reporting of local revenue, with shortfalls in skills, connectivity and POS devices.
The Independent reports the Auditor General reviewed IRAS implementation in a sample of 30 local governments for FY2024/25, out of 124 local governments budgeted for local revenue.
